title: With iOS18 Reminders is once again a top productivity app
body:
What really disliked for so many updates is that I had to necessarily choose other third party apps to manage my tasks. With iOS18 it’s no longer the case. The app is very polished and with useful features. 

Just a small suggestion: add the due date and task date as different dates. Things3 and Todoist already have this feature.
